verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check calendars, find open times, book meetings, and manage links from a chat. That describes an official MCP server delivering the core story. Support rests on a single first-party sentence with no further detail. Missing for 10: MCP server setup and connection docs (endpoint, auth flow), an enumerated tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
